notes: Not a wall-thickness matrix: one row per profile, every cell filled. The header strip has two text lines and no table-wide caption: line 1 = "Žymėjimas", "Teorinis metro svoris (kg/m)" and the group header "Matmenys"; line 2 = the sub-labels "h", "b", "s", "t", "r", which all belong to the group "Matmenys" (no unit is printed for them; mm by context). "Matmenys" is put in "caption" only because it is the text printed above the labels h/b/s/t/r - it is a group header for the dimension columns and does not span the first two columns. Column assignment checked by x-position (header label x / body value x, px): 2/3, 191/192, h 436/436, b 557/557, s 678/678, t 798/799, r 920/920. Body has no grid lines and no zebra striping; the row background colour is a stock code explained by the legend printed under the table: darker blue = "Laikoma sandėlyje" (rows UPE 80 - UPE 270, 10 rows), light grey-blue = "Tiekiama pagal užsakymą" (rows UPE 300 - UPE 400, 4 rows). Decimal separator printed as a dot; trailing zeros kept as printed (7.90, 4.0, 10.0). Text is a non-antialiased bitmap font; every glyph was matched exactly against digit templates (pixel-exact round trip JSON -> glyphs -> image, 0 mismatches in 98 cells), then all rows were re-read visually at 2x and 6x.
